nodes.label: First-Surface Mirror Physics & Chemical Delamination

nodes.label: Tangential Non-Linearity and Pincushion Distortion
nodes.rationale: Flat projection surfaces distort angular galvanometer sweeps according to X = L * tan(2*theta); non-linear distortion increases toward field edges, requiring geometric correction or LUT compensation.

nodes.label: 28BYJ-48 4-Wire Bipolar Conversion Method
nodes.rationale: Severing the central common 5V VCC trace on the motor PCB decouples the two center-tapped coils, turning unipolar motor into true 4-wire bipolar stepper with 2x torque.
